stem:
Nidhi crushes a lump of rock salt into fine grains. She then stirs some of those grains in a glass of water until they can no longer be seen.

Which statement best explains what has happened to the rock salt?

options.text: The rock salt has become nothing, because no grains can be seen.
The rock salt is still present as extremely small particles that are too small to see.
Crushing and dissolving destroy every particle of the rock salt.
The rock salt has changed into something that was never salt.

teacher.key_rationale: Breaking, grinding, and dissolving show matter is made of extremely small particles. The salt is still there; it has not become nothing.
